paragraphs: Rabbi Yosi bar Abbahu, in the time of Rav Sheshet, is mentioned in Bava Kamma 112b.

notes.text: The whole Davidson Bava Kamma 112b paragraph fully names Rabbi Yosei bar Avahu and has Rav Sheshet address him; Chullin 49a fully names Rav Shmuel son of Rabbi Avahu. These support the local full titles for Yosi and Shmuel. The supplied untitled fathers and the two separate pointers remain; the fathers are not identified with each other, and no title is added to Hyman’s father wording.
